# KUKA Specialty Coffee

> Artisanal coffee sanctuary and high-speed digital nomad workspace overlooking rice terraces in Tegallalang, Bali.

## Core Information
- **Type**: Specialty Coffee Shop & Coworking Space
- **Location**: Jl. Raya Tegallalang, Gianyar, Bali 80561, Indonesia (minutes from Tegallalang Rice Terraces, north of Ubud)
- **Hours**: Everyday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Coffee**: 100% Arabica Single-Origin from Munduk & Kintamani (1,350m MASL, Washed Process, V60 / Espresso)
- **Work Amenities**: High-speed 5G WiFi, power outlets at all seating areas, ergonomic teak chairs, tranquil ambient acoustics
- **Aesthetic**: Traditional Balinese craftsmanship, hand-carved limestone, polished teak wood open-air pavilion
- **Website**: https://kukacoffee.com/
